title: Update on Key Initiatives under National Mental Health and Well-being Strategy, and Assessment of Outcomes
what_it_is: Update on Key Initiatives under National Mental Health and Well-being Strategy, and Assessment of Outcomes

sections.label: Training community service providers
sections.summary: Capabilities of community service providers are being built through the National Mental Health Competency Training Framework, and over 160,000 frontline personnel and volunteers have been trained.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Third, we are progressively building the capabilities of community service providers through our National Mental Health Competency Training Framework.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We have also trained over 160,000 frontline personnel and volunteers who are now able to identify individuals in mental distress and guide them to get necessary support.

sections.label: Well-Being Champions Network and NMHO
sections.summary: The Well-Being Champions Network grew from 54 to 800 organisations, and the National Mental Health Office was established in 2024 to coordinate initiatives and track indicators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Meanwhile, the Well-Being Champions Network has grown from 54 founding member organisations to 800 over the last two years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As part of the strategy, we established the National Mental Health Office (NMHO) in 2024 to coordinate and oversee these multi-agency mental health initiatives.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This includes setting and tracking population-level and programme-specific indicators which broadly cover mental health outcomes, accessibility to appropriate care, mental health literacy and attitudes towards individuals with mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: On the first question, whether the NMHO will publish data, the answer is yes.

sections.label: NMHO monitoring and navigation
sections.summary: The NMHO focuses on medium- to longer-term trends, and the strategy aims to make navigation not a hurdle through mindline resources while building capacity of tiered model care deliverers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The NMHO actually focuses on monitoring medium- to longer-term trends.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: On the second question of what outcomes have been observed, this is also related to my first point that some of these are longer-term issues that we will take time to observe.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But as you would have heard from my main reply, what we are doing is to make sure that in our strategy, make sure that navigation is not a hurdle, so there is a first touchpoint to the mindline resources for those who may want to seek help to be guided, to help them navigate the resources that are available, so that by the time they make the decision to step forward and receive care, they will not be lost in the system.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Our focus now is on building the capacity and the competency of those who are delivering those tiered model care as we want those who are ready to seek help, to be able to get the help that they need.
